versions.content: The V2X Management module shall implement a protected zone center position list. The minimum is to build in the official list provided by the ASECAP (not supposed to be updated except by a firmware update). Protected Zones with identical protectedZone ID may be seen as a single station. In case the ASECAP database and the CEN-DSRC mitigation CAMs contains a valid protection zone with the identical protectedZone ID mitigation shall be done only based on the CEN-DSRC mitigation CAM content.
